title: Forest Guard & Forester (Group-C, Non-Gazetted)
salary: Forest Guard: Level-6 (Rs. 5700-24000 + GP 2100)			Forester: Level-7 (Rs. 5700-24000 + GP 2200)
age_limit: Age Limit: 18-40 years as on 01 May 2026. || Upper age relaxation of 5 years is admissible for SC/ST candidates and Government employees.
selection_process: Selection will be done through: || Written Examination (85% marks) || Interview (15% marks) || Only candidates securing cut-off marks in the written test will be called for interview. Final selection is subject to medical fitness. || Written Test Syllabus: || For Forest Guard: Mathematics (20), English (30), General Knowledge (120), Interview (30). Bengali/Kokborok is qualifying in nature (Min 40%). || For Forester: Mathematics (20), English (20), General Knowledge (100), Science (30), Interview (30). Bengali/Kokborok is qualifying in nature (Min 40%).

title: Assistant Technical Officer (ATO), Group-B, Gazetted
qualification: Percentage of marks in the minimum prescribed educational qualification (if age is also equal)
salary: Pay Band-3: Rs. 10230–34,800/-, Grade Pay Rs. 4800/- (Level-13, Tripura State Pay Matrix 2018)
age_limit: Candidates must be at least 18 years and not more than 40 years of age as on 05-06-2026. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for ST, SC, Physically Handicapped, and Government employee candidates. However, Government Employees belonging to ST/SC/Physically Handicapped category shall not get this additional relaxation over and above the general relaxation of 5 years already available to them. || There is no fixed number of attempts for the examination - candidates can apply and appear multiple times as long as they are otherwise eligible and within the prescribed upper age limit for their category.
application_fee: Rs. 350/- (Rupees Three Hundred and Fifty only)
